{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
penguins = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/penguins.csv')

# Drop rows where body_mass_g is missing
penguins_clean = penguins.dropna(subset=['body_mass_g'])

# Confirm the number of rows after dropping
print(f'Number of penguins after dropping missing body_mass_g: {len(penguins_clean)}')

# Compute the mean body mass in grams
mean_body_mass = penguins_clean['body_mass_g'].mean()
print(f'Mean body mass: {mean_body_mass}')

# Return the mean value only
mean_body_mass"}
